'''Lulupo''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Momopo]] at 6 bronze stars/19 copies, and evolves into [[Lilypo]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Don't assume Lulupo is always eating and soaking in the tub. Aerobics are a regular part of the routine for staying in shape. Eat more, move more. Simple as that."

Lulupo is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A hippopotamus that wears a short pink skirt. Its body is brown with a lighter brown underside. It also seems to be wearing pink lipstick and its eyes are purple.

Lulupo's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes the color of its pink skirt to purple, and its body becomes reddish-brown instead of brown.

== Evolution Trial ==
Lulupo's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Lilypo]] you need to complete the following two tasks:
* Feed Lulupo to increase stats 3 times.
* In [[Island Gold Rush]] use 5,000 energy drinks.

== Trivia ==
* Lulupo and its evolutions were added to the game on 6/3/2026 alongside [[Cosmoram]] and [[Heliabloom]].
